release_read.basis: Clean miss on every line: Q3 sales $1.59bn (-9%, LatAm -31%) vs ~$1.77bn consensus, operating EPS $0.06 vs $0.09, and the first standalone 2026 operating EBITDA guide cut to $1.10-1.125bn from ~$1.3bn at the September investor day (-14%); at ~6x EBITDA and near-zero net debt that is worth about the option-implied 9.5%, softened slightly by the -10.75% pre-print drift and the low multiple.

release.released_at_note: Released 2026-11-11 after the close (amc, per brief and the 8-K dated 2026-11-11); exact minute not retrieved.

key_line.detail: FY2026 adjusted pro forma operating EBITDA guided to $1.10-1.125bn and operating EPS $0.76-0.80, against ~$1.3bn standalone EBITDA set at the 2026-09-15 investor day; Latin America organic sales -31% (volume -24%, price -7%), price -7% overall on Brazil generics and US acetochlor. Exactly the peer-destocking line the thesis named.

guidance.detail: FY2026 operating EBITDA $1.10-1.125bn vs ~$1.3bn investor-day target (about -14%; prior figure from the hunt's investor-day source https://quartr.com/events/corteva-inc-ctva-investor-day-2026_3Y0NpwEb). No 2027 commentary in the release. New restructuring $130-140m; first post-spin dividend authorised.

call.detail: Call is today 2026-11-12 at 10:30 ET, during the session: Brazil channel inventory, Q4 phasing and any 2027 frame land after the open. An exit at the open avoids it.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions dated this morning were found in search; search results surfaced only stale pre-spin targets. Release itself frames weaker Brazil conditions. Retail tone not observed.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 10.52 (-13.3% vs 12.14 close) against release read -10% and implied 9.5%; after-hours was -8.0% and the pre-market extended down to the low (10.50) by 09:14, 122 prints, 26 in the last 30 minutes, not stale. Market weak (SPY -0.7%, QQQ -1.4%). The short is up about 12.5% from the 12.025 entry.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was peer LatAm destocking hitting a CP consensus still at +4% and the first standalone guide: sales -9% with LatAm -31% and a ~14% EBITDA guide cut is the thesis landing, larger than the hunt sized (-0.84 scaled).

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market that kept trending to its low into 09:14, so the open should hold nearly all of the -13% move; the gap is beyond the implied move and beyond what the release alone supports, so a partial fade toward the close by 10:00 is the more likely path, with the 10:30 call a two-sided risk after it.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de short-these duidelijk (omzet en winst onder verwachting, jaarprognose fors verlaagd), maar de voorbeurs staat al ongeveer 13% lager, meer dan de cijfers en de optieprijzen rechtvaardigen. Grote koersgaten na cijfers van de avond ervoor geven vaak een deel terug, en om 10:30 volgt de conference call, dus de winst van ruim 12% bij de opening nemen.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs voor 09:30 verder wegzakt onder 10,50 met veel transacties en er nog koersdoelverlagingen binnenkomen, dan is vasthouden tot 10:00 te verdedigen.
